recentItems.title: Mamdani announces plan to close NYC’s notorious Rikers Island jail
recentItems.description:
New York City’s Rikers Island jail complex would close by 2032 under a sweeping plan announced Friday by Mayor Zohran Mamdani, whose strategy for finally shuttering the notorious facility hinges on substantially reducing the number of people kept behind bars.

recentItems.title: LIVE: Andy Burnham and EU leaders conference on strengthening post-Brexit ties
recentItems.description: Watch live as British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President António Costa hold a press conference at the second EU-UK summit in Brussels. The meeting aims to strengthen ties a decade after Britain voted to leave the bloc, with Burnham calling it a step toward repairing the damage caused by Brexit.

recentItems.title: AP reporter says Texas execution was like no other he's witnessed before
recentItems.description:
Texas executed Reinaldo Dennes on Thursday in a procedure that lasted 63 minutes. Associated Press reporter Michael Graczyk, who has covered capital punishment in Texas since 1983 and witnessed nearly 500 executions, said Dennes' execution was unlike any he had seen before.

recentItems.title: LIVE: Workers march in Rome during a nationwide general strike
recentItems.description:
Watch live as workers march through Rome during a 24-hour general strike across Italy. The country's largest trade union confederation, the CGIL, called for the strike across the public and private sectors over the cost of living and the government's budget proposals.
